name: Fan
dimensions: Width 43 cm; Length 25 cm; Length 25 cm; Width 2.5 cm
summary: This fan illustrates a mixture of European and Chinese versions of the 18th-century Chinoiserie style.  The sticks are Chinese and the painted leaf is an attempt by an English or Dutch artist to copy genuine Chinese paintings.  It was not uncommon for the fan sticks to be imported from China. Europe
